EarLoft is a player for your own collection: music, podcasts and books, from this device and from the network, each in one shared library. Music also comes from your Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin or Emby servers, podcasts from any feed, and books from your Audiobookshelf server. Everything can be downloaded for offline listening, book progress is synced with your server, and music, podcasts and books also play on your Wear OS watch.
For more information and the source code, see GitHub:
Please report bugs and feature requests in the issue tracker:

RSS feeds, podcasts on this device

EarLoft plays your own collection: music from your Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin or Emby server, podcasts from any feed and audiobooks from Audiobookshelf, plus the files on this device. Everything can be downloaded and also plays on your Wear OS watch and in Android Auto.
